text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса gets injured during
training, so I
bring her to the infirmary.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An injury like this is nothing to the
world's
strongest racer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
There's no need for your concern! Your
time is
better spent preparing for my
inevitable return to
racing!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: B-but Trainer! I said I'm all right!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You should head back to your offi—Ack!
Ouchie.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Uhhh... well...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I think I just got a little careless...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: True. You weren't fired up enough.

text_block_list.text: I think I just got a little careless...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: True. You weren't fired up enough.

text_block_list.text: No way! It's my fault!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I'm just weak... I'm... I'm...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Aaaugh! I want to get even stronger! I need to!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Let's focus on healing up first.

text_block_list.text: Entiendo! Sorry for all the trouble!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yes... reflection,
introspection—soul-searching...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
My papa's gonna be so angry about
this...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Just be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.text: Not... fired up enough?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Grrr! Me?! Not fired up?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Di que no es verdad! Say it ain't so!
That's not me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'm fired up, Trainer! You can
count on me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll be hella careful during
training from
now on...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
With that declaration, she recovers from
her
injury in a few days and performs
better in
training than ever before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After some much needed rest, El Condor
Pasa is
fully recovered and overflowing
with
determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
